residuals.detail: `padtmp` and `sha1tmp` (secret-derived SSLv3 master-secret state) are stack locals that are not cleansed on the early-failure returns; only the success path leaves the function. The same shape exists in src/digest/md5_sha1.rs (`ossl_md5_sha1_ctrl`). Reached from sha1::set_ctx_params / md5_sha1::set_ctx_params with an application supplied master secret.
residuals.why_not_fixed: The fix is in a different file that this receipt does not own; changing it needs its own site enumeration and the batch gate. It is not reclassified as safe.

residuals.detail: The authority's sha1_set_ctx_params/md5_sha1_set_ctx_params has the same non-cleansing failure paths; conserving it would reproduce a known secret-lifetime weakness. Recorded as a deliberate open divergence pending the digest/sha1.rs fix.
